title: attributeGenomeIdSol's join algorithm has ZERO behavioral requirement in behavioral-spec.md; the only description lives in verification-architecture.md as a one-line label, and PM's own join key (market===task) is silently inapplicable to SOL
description:
REQ-012 (behavioral-spec.md:250-264) only specifies the WRITE side: 'record the SAME genome_id ... into state/sol-trade.trace.jsonl ... timestamped at or before the pass's own live-pass line.' It never specifies the READ/JOIN side -- the actual matching algorithm a later attributeGenomeIdSol() must use to recover which genome_id produced a given confirmed swap row. The ONLY place this algorithm is named at all is verification-architecture.md:13-14 ('attributeGenomeIdSol(ledgerRow, traceLines) -- REQ-012/013 (timestamp-ordered join, given arrays already in memory; no I/O itself)') -- a parenthetical inside the Purity Boundary Map, not a behavioral requirement.

This matters because PM's own attributeGenomeId (evolve.mjs:86-97) joins on `t.market === ledgerRow.task` -- but sol-trade's earn-ledger row's `task` field is a FIXED constant string (record-swap.mjs:19: `task = "jupiter swap round-trip"`), never a per-mint/per-pass discriminator. An implementer following REQ-012's 'Mirrors' pointer to PM's mechanism (behavioral-spec.md:251-252) without also reading verification-architecture.md's one-liner could easily attempt a market/task-field match (as PM does) -- which would NEVER match for SOL (the ledger row's task is always the same fixed string, and nothing in the spec tells the genome-linked trace line to set a matching field), silently breaking attribution for EVERY realized swap.

The money-safety consequence is severe and SILENT: if the join never matches, REQ-013's 'unattributed row counts toward NO genome' edge case (behavioral-spec.md:283-285) swallows the failure as if it were the expected rare case, when it would actually be the UNIVERSAL case -- REQ-014's promotion gate would never see any mutant genome accumulate >= minRedeems, permanently defeating the entire evolvable-edge mechanism this feature exists to build, with no crash, no error, and no trace signal distinguishing 'cold start, not enough real volume yet' (expected, REQ-014's own documented edge case) from 'the join is silently broken' (a real bug). Nothing in the spec or the proof table can tell these two states apart.

Proof-table gap: PROP-012 (verification-architecture.md:49) only tests that a genome-linked line EXISTS with ts <= the live-pass line -- it does not test that the line is actually JOINABLE later. PROP-013 (verification-architecture.md:50) only tests row filtering (source/sig/confirmed), never end-to-end attribution. No property test in the table constructs a realistic multi-pass sequence (including a WAIT/no-fill pass followed by a filled pass with a DIFFERENT genome_id, e.g. after a mutation) and asserts the correct genome_id is recovered for the real swap.

evidence.snippet: WHEN the pre-gate's decision is engage === true AND franklin-trading start is subsequently invoked for that pass, THE SYSTEM SHALL record the SAME genome_id (and full genome values) into state/sol-trade.trace.jsonl ... so a later offline join (REQ-013/014) can attribute a realized swap's P&L to the genome that was active when the pass that produced it ran.

fix: Add an explicit REQ (or extend REQ-012/013) in behavioral-spec.md stating the exact join algorithm in plain EARS terms: 'attributeGenomeIdSol matches a confirmed sol-trade ledger row to the MOST RECENT PRECEDING sol-gate/sol-trade genome-linked trace line by TIMESTAMP ONLY -- there is no market/task-field match (sol-trade's ledger task field carries no per-pass discriminator, unlike PM's redeem.task===bet.market) -- and this is sufficient BECAUSE sol-trade/run.sh runs single-slot/non-overlapping passes, so at most one genome-linked line can precede any given swap's timestamp without an intervening pass.' Add a Tier-2 property test (extend PROP-012/013 or add PROP-012b) that runs a synthetic multi-pass sequence (>=1 no-fill pass, >=2 filled passes across a mutation boundary with different genome_ids) and asserts each swap is attributed to the CORRECT genome_id, not merely that a line exists.
